name: EditorialEmptyPanel

props.description: Illustrated guest panel or dashed empty panel. Default: "guest".
props.name: variant

tagline: A centred panel for a signed-out or an empty state (gh#1439). `variant="guest"` draws a decorative three-card stack above kicker, title, copy and centred actions; `variant="empty"` is dashed with a round icon medallion. Geometry: `--editorial-empty-panel-*`.
usage: DO use variant="guest" where a page needs an account, variant="empty" for a collection with nothing in it.
